relationships.subject: LIF
relationships.evidence_quote: 12Zs secreted significantly higher concentrations of vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) with all treatment doses compared to PBS

relationships.subject: LIF
relationships.evidence_quote: Significant production of immune recruiting cytokines such as monocyte chemoattractant protein (MCP)-1 and MCP-3 were produced in 12Zs and HUVECs upon LIF treatment

relationships.subject: LIF
relationships.evidence_quote: CD206+ small peritoneal macrophages (SPMs; gated as: singlet, live, side scatter (SSC)low, CD11b+, F4/80mid, MHCIIhi, CD206+) and Treg (gated as: singlet, live, SSClow, CD11b-, F4/80-, MHCII-, CD3+, CD4+, CD25+, FOXP3+) cells were significantly decreased compared to PBS control

key_findings: LIF is present in endometriosis ectopic lesions and peritoneal fluid; LIF mRNA is downregulated while LIFR is upregulated in ectopic tissue.
LIF promotes VEGF, MCP-1/3 and HUVEC tube formation in vitro and reduces CD206+ SPMs and Tregs in a mouse endometriosis model.
